marks.caption: Pick a scenario. Everything shown here is synthetic demo data.
Starting creates a private demo workspace, already loaded with sample data.
New reports arrive as raw text, spreadsheets and documents.
One click runs AI extraction. No outside model is needed for this demo.
The raw report becomes structured fields, each with a confidence score.
Anything uncertain goes to a person. Original text on the left, evidence on the right.
A human confirms the fact, so it can be trusted.
A fixed rule checks the facts and fires. Every condition it tested is shown.
A case is opened automatically, with an owner, priority and evidence.
The follow-up actions are already assigned.
The system proposes an action but never acts alone. High-risk choices need a person.
The approver records why, in their own words.
The dashboards update from that single approval.
Every step is kept in an audit trail, in order.
Same flow, applied to your own operations.
